sources.title: Third-party summary of Google Workspace per-user prices (Business Starter/Standard/Plus)

limits.en: Free personal @gmail.com account with 15GB storage shared across Gmail, Drive and Photos.

keyLimits.en: Custom @company email via Gmail, 30GB pooled storage per user, no Gemini AI features. Price is a third-party estimate, not independently confirmed on workspace.google.com's interactive calculator in this session.
2TB pooled storage per user, adds Gemini AI in Docs/Sheets/Slides/Drive/Meet/Chat. Price is a third-party estimate.
5TB pooled storage per user, adds eSignature with Docs/PDFs. Price is a third-party estimate.
5TB+ storage per user (expandable on request), no minimum or maximum user count, unlike Starter/Standard/Plus which cap at 300 users.

cautions.en: Business Starter/Standard/Plus per-user prices come from a third-party summary, not directly confirmed on workspace.google.com's official pricing page in this session, which requires an interactive calculator for exact figures.
Business Starter, Standard and Plus plans are capped at a maximum of 300 users; only Enterprise has no user limit.

capabilities.en: Free @gmail.com email with 15GB storage shared across Gmail, Drive and Photos.
Business email with custom domain and pooled per-user storage (30GB to 5TB+) via Google Workspace plans.
AI features (Gemini in Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive, Meet, Chat) available from Business Standard tier upward.

limitations.en: Free personal tier lacks a custom domain and is limited to 15GB storage shared across all Google services.
Business Starter plan does not include Gemini AI features, which require at least the Standard tier.

unknowns: Official per-user dollar prices for Business Starter/Standard/Plus not confirmed directly on workspace.google.com's official pricing page in this session (it requires an interactive calculator); figures used here come from a third-party source and should be re-verified.
